dispositions.details: All five native transformations represented; native generic final NAD(P) reaction expands to exactly two experimentally supported cofactor alternatives, not consecutive chemistry.
Old 2-dehydrogenase prose is inconsistent with native C1 reaction and primary/current reviewed 1-dehydrogenase identity.

Old CPD-16503 R-SLA comment links conflict with the native reaction substrates/products and current Rhea/UniProt S-SLA/S-SL. Exact native selected compound InChIs match ChEBI. HPLC-MS is not relabeled as a direct enantiomeric assay.
The native KDPG-family analogy is rejected: full 2015 Discussion identifies COG3836 distinct from KDPG COG0800. No KDPG absolute inactivity is asserted after the 2026 abstract.
Native generic NAD-P-OR-NOP and NADH-P-OR-NOP classes cover NAD and NADP alternatives. Current Rhea47928 and47932 master equations and primary2015 support both.
The broad native pathway link is not an extra reaction or current endpoint; selected terminal native reaction uses CPD-11799.
Predicted SQ-glycoside hydrolysis, mutarotation, transport and regulator assignments are outside the exact five-member pathway; no unsupported gene-product IDs/causal edges added.
